findings.claim: Adding 'Accept-Query' only to the `RequestHeader` type union may leave a companion runtime list (or a parallel `ResponseHeader` union) out of sync.
findings.rationale: Header-name modules like this commonly pair the literal union with a runtime array/Set used for validation or completion, and often split request vs response header unions. The diff only touches this one union; if a sibling constant or the response-header union exists, it will no longer cover 'Accept-Query'. Note also that Accept-Query (like the neighboring Accept-Patch/Accept-Post) is defined as a *response* header advertising QUERY support, so placing it in `RequestHeader` may be semantically wrong depending on how this type is consumed. Low confidence — I can only see this hunk, so this needs verification against the rest of the file/module.
